testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.mechanics.death.UntradeableDeathProtectionTests

testcase.name: above level 20 an unlocked untradeable is destroyed for coins
loot keys, conversions and emblems keep their own rules
a destroyed untradeable is recorded for Perdu at its repair price
rune pouch keeps the empty pouch below 20 and is destroyed above 20 when unlocked
below level 20 a lockable untradeable breaks and the killer gets the repair price
an already damaged item is never paid out twice
N552 an already broken high-tier item is lost above level 20 for nothing, kept below 20, low tier kept everywhere
a lost untradeable is recorded for Perdu at its store value, a Lost Property item is not
a locked item breaks below 20 and is mangled above 20 for 500k
a broken quiver never keeps the ammo that went to the killer
a non-lockable untradeable is always lost and the killer gets its high alchemy value
repair price is the OSRS amount, else 25 percent of the store price with a 10k floor
an untradeable item such as Arclight is handled, a tradeable one is not
